title: 第八百章 马失前蹄第七百九十九章 谈谈
slug: 仙魂斗战第八百零四章闹事生非
lines: 毕竟此时的冯斗也是没有其他的办法了，只能是见步行步啦！
莫贵来到最前面的地方，他说：“有请天下棋盘！”
话音刚落时，从天而降下来一个巨大的棋盘，渐渐地从天而降下落的棋子，很快就已经是布好整个棋局，直接出现一个棋笥，里面都是白色的棋子。
他开始观察整个棋盘，毕竟既然都已经是属于残局的棋盘，自然不能够按照全新的棋盘来看待了，自然需要好好地观察一番，只有这样才可以做到解出真正的迷局，往往来说，越是残局越需要好好地观察，甚至来说，这些东西很奇妙的。
不到他们能够着急得来的，一旦着急就可以会陷入败局了，真的是应了那句话，越急就越容易出错啦！
就这样就已经是在这里静静地观察了三天，可是莫贵一直都盯着棋盘看，他从来不会轻易地动手，哪怕冯斗在一旁问了不少关于棋艺方面的东西，他也只是解答过后继续在这里关注这个棋盘。
大约过了接近三天之后，他终于开始动手了，他一子下去之后，仿佛整个局面倾向他这边了，他的嘴角不由得露出一丝丝的笑容，然而对方很快就已经下了第二颗棋子，局面继续向他倾向的，他的嘴角笑容却越来越浓了。
就在莫贵下第二颗棋子时，他瞬间将一大片的黑棋子吃掉，仿佛这样一来让莫贵占尽优势了，毕竟很多时候，他都觉得自己将会取胜了，他按照自己的想法继续进行下去，他下完第二颗棋子时，他感觉自己在整个棋盘上占尽优势，只需要他继续下棋，不出二十子，他就能够取得最终的胜利，他的内心不由得感叹自己这三百年都不是盖的，他这次终于可以完成啦！
就在此时，他觉得自己离成功只有一步之遥啦！

当他下到第五颗棋子时，他原本开心的表情瞬间变成了痛苦的，也许只有他自己才能够明白了，他此时才感受到骑虎难下的感觉，他原本放在棋笥的手，渐渐地拿开了，他轻声一句道：“我已经输了，真的是棋高一着了，我原本以为这一切都已经在自己掌控之中了，可是现在才真正地明白这一切只不过是他们为我设下了的一个陷阱而已。看来我还是太小看这个天下棋牌的实力，也许这一切都是天意啦！整个试炼时间为十年，如果我没有办法在固定时间突破所有的关卡，就永远不可能完成最后的黄泉阴阳眼争夺啦！”
冯斗此时也是能够看得出七七八八的，毕竟这个东西说起来还是不错的，甚至来说，让他们都已经觉得这里有点诡异的，毕竟他们的目的已经太明显了，那就是夺得黄泉阴阳眼。
正是如此，就已经不由得让整个局面变得相当尴尬了，哪怕是冯斗都觉得莫贵此时会取胜，哪怕就算不会输得这样惨的，可是结果却让他大大地失望啦！
此时全新的残局已经出现了，冯斗看了一眼棋局时，他笑道：“莫老哥，是不是在棋盘上取胜就可以了吗？”
莫贵有点不解道：“当然啦！”
冯斗听到这一句话还是相当高兴的，他疑问道：“既然如此，不管我用什么办法都可以吧？”
莫贵这个时候更加不解道：“当然啦！棋盘上下棋，不管你用什么技巧和阴谋的，只要你能够取胜才不管你用什么办法呢？”
冯斗听到这一番话时，他露出了笑容，他此时诡异一笑，他说：“既然如此就好办了，我曾经听说过一句话，一盘棋之中，除了执棋者之外，还有一个人能够取胜，然而哪怕是执棋者也不可能在他的手中取胜。”
这样一说，不由得让莫贵也一下来了兴趣，他笑道：“任何的棋盘不是只有执棋者能够决定当中的胜败吗？还有谁能够呢？这个说法，我还是第一次听，你倒是好好地说说，让我也可以开开眼界的，如果真的有这样的人，那就代表着我这三百年苦学完全地白白地浪费时间，那样就真的丢脸够大啦！以后都不敢说自己真的是棋艺高超啦！”
“哈哈！很多时候，你们只是棋盘执行者，你们只不过是将棋盘者的意志执行下去而已！可是说到底只不过是在人家设定范围之内行事，既然要胜之，自然不可以短暂的提升，就在这时，我们需要做到的事情就是打破这个局面，只有这样才能够做到取胜，这个就是最佳的取胜的办法，打破别人为自己设置的规则，从而设立全新的规则，由我们自己设立的规矩！这样我们就可以立于不败之地。”
“打败规矩，自己设立规矩！”
莫贵不由得默默地默念着，他内心暗暗地思着冯斗所说这句话的真实含义到底是什么？
正当莫贵还在思考的时候，就听到冯斗大声一叫：“给老子去死啦！”
就在此时，冯斗的头顶上凝结了一个巨大天雷，莫贵看到这一刻时，他不由得一惊，他内心里想：莫非是要炸掉这个棋盘吗？他不怕被这里的规则直接灭杀了吗？真的胆子够大的，真的是不亏能够建立帝盟的人，真的不是一般人能够比拟得了的主，看来真的是越来越有意思啦！
就莫贵在考虑的时候，冯斗头顶上那个雷彻底地击中那个棋盘，原本雷击就是具有超强的毁灭性，再加上冯斗本身就是雷道意志大成者。
所以他使用雷击绝对不是一般人能够使得出的，哪怕莫贵自认为刚刚的那道雷击打在自己的身上，他哪怕不是一身伤也是伤得不轻的，毕竟很多时候遇到雷击，也不是很多人敢迎接雷击的，没有几个人敢接受这一番毁灭之力的。
然而那个棋盘直接被雷击碎了，甚至来说，任何完整的碎片，渐渐地一个声音传了过来，恭喜冯斗和莫贵共同通关成功，这一下子就已经让莫贵觉得相当吃惊的，他也是算得上因祸得福的节奏。
他笑道：“难怪那么多人通不过这一关，真的算得上足以笑死人啦！居然是这样才可以通过的关卡，试问一句，再给我一百次机会，我都不可能通过这一关的，甚至来说，以我这种循规蹈矩的人，是永远不可能做到的。”
冯斗则笑道：“这样不就是我是乱来的呢？”
“哈哈！冯老弟，老哥这一把真的是依靠你的光啦！不然我绝对不可能完成这关的，不用多说，以后只要用得上老哥的地方，老哥绝对不会有任何拒绝的，绝对给你完成得好好的。”
冯斗刚刚那一句话当然也是开玩笑的，他听到了莫贵的话，自然是明白他所说的意思，他笑道：“莫老哥，你实在太客气了，我们能够通关也在一定程度上算得上巧合啦！我刚刚也是报着试一试的心态，只能够我们的运气实在太好了，不然也不可能成功啦！既然如此，我们要不要进入下一关呢？”
莫贵想了想之后，他说：“还是要等等老邱吧！”
content_en:
After all, Feng Dou had no other choice at this time but to just walk around!
Mo Gui came to the front and said, "I invite the world to play the chessboard!"
As soon as he finished speaking, a huge chessboard descended from the sky, and chess pieces gradually fell from the sky. Soon the entire chess game was laid out, and a chessboard appeared directly, which was filled with white chess pieces.
He began to observe the entire chessboard. After all, since it is already an endgame chessboard, naturally it cannot be viewed as a brand new chessboard. Naturally, it needs to be carefully observed. Only in this way can the real puzzle be solved. Generally speaking, the closer the endgame is, the more careful observation is needed. In fact, these things are very wonderful.
If they can't get it in a hurry, once they get anxious, they may fall into defeat. It really goes with that sentence. The more anxious you are, the easier it is to make mistakes!
They have been quietly observing here for three days, but Mo Gui has been staring at the chessboard. He never takes action easily. Even if Feng Dou asked a lot about chess skills, he would only answer the questions and continue to pay attention to the chessboard here.
After about three days, he finally started to take action. After he made a move, it seemed that the whole situation was tilted towards him. A smile could not help but appear on the corner of his mouth. However, the opponent soon made a second piece, and the situation continued to tilt towards him, and the smile on his mouth became thicker and thicker.
Just when Mo Gui played the second chess piece, he instantly consumed a large piece of black chess pieces, as if this gave Mo Gui an advantage. After all, many times, he felt that he would win. He continued according to his own ideas. After he finished playing the second piece When he picked up a chess piece, he felt that he had the advantage on the entire chessboard. As long as he continued to play chess, he would be able to achieve the final victory within twenty pieces. He couldn't help but sigh in his heart that he had not been able to do it for three hundred years. He could finally finish it this time!
At this moment, he felt that he was only one step away from success!
When he got to the fifth chess piece, his originally happy expression instantly turned into pain. Perhaps only he himself could understand it. Only then did he feel the feeling of riding a tiger with difficulty. His hand that was originally on the chess piece gradually took it away. He said softly: "I have lost. I really had a better move. I originally thought that everything was under my control." I won, but now I really understand that all this is just a trap they set for me. It seems that I still underestimated the strength of this world chess and card game. Maybe all this is God's will! The entire trial lasts for ten years. If I can't break through all the levels in a fixed time, I will never be able to complete the final battle for the Yin and Yang Eyes of Huang Quan!"
Feng Dou could also see clearly at this time. After all, this thing sounded good, and even made them feel that it was a bit weird here. After all, their purpose was too obvious, which was to win the Yin and Yang Eyes of Huangquan.
Just like this, the whole situation could not help but become quite embarrassing. Even Feng Dou thought that Mo Gui would win at this time, even if he would not lose so miserably, but the result disappointed him greatly!
At this time, a new endgame had appeared. When Feng Dou took a look at the chess game, he smiled and said, "Brother Mo, is it enough to win on the chessboard?"
Mo Gui was a little confused and said: "Of course!"
Feng Dou was quite happy to hear this, and he asked: "In that case, no matter what method I use, it will be fine, right?"
Mo Gui was even more puzzled at this time and said: "Of course! When playing chess on the chessboard, no matter what skills or schemes you use, as long as you can win, it doesn't matter what method you use?"
When Feng Dou heard these words, he smiled. He smiled strangely at this time and said: "In that case, it is easy to handle. I once heard a saying that in a game of chess, besides the chess player, there is one person who can win. However, even the chess player cannot win in his hands."
Saying this, Mo Gui couldn't help but become interested. He smiled and said: "On any chessboard, isn't it only the chess player who can decide the outcome? Who else can? This is the first time I have heard this statement. You should explain it carefully and it will open my eyes. If there is such a person, it means that my three hundred years of hard study have been a complete waste of time. That would be really embarrassing! I will not dare to say that I am really superb in chess in the future!"
"Haha! Many times, you are just the players on the chessboard, and you are just executing the will of the players on the chessboard! But in the final analysis, you are just acting within the scope set by others. Since you want to win, naturally you cannot improve temporarily. At this time, what we need to do is to break this situation. Only in this way can we win. This is the best way to win, break the rules set by others, and establish new rules, rules set by ourselves! In this way, we can be invincible."
“Break the rules and make your own!”
Mo Gui couldn't help but recite silently. He secretly thought about the true meaning of Feng Dou's words.
While Mo Gui was still thinking, he heard Feng Dou shout loudly: "Go to hell!"
At this moment, a huge thunder condensed on top of Feng Dou's head. When Mo Gui saw this moment, he couldn't help being shocked. He thought in his heart: Could it be that he wanted to blow up this chessboard? Isn't he afraid of being directly killed by the rules here? He is really brave enough, he is really worthy of being able to establish the Imperial Alliance, and he is really not a master that ordinary people can compare with. It seems to be getting more and more interesting!
While Mo Gui was thinking about it, the thunder above Feng Dou's head completely hit the chessboard. Lightning strikes were originally extremely destructive, and Feng Dou himself was a master of the will of thunder.
Therefore, his use of lightning strikes is definitely not something that ordinary people can do. Even if Mo Gui thought that the lightning strike just hit him, he would be seriously injured even if he was not injured. After all, many people often encounter lightning strikes, and not many people dare to welcome lightning strikes. Few people dare to accept such destructive power.
However, the chessboard was directly shattered by lightning, or even any complete fragments. Gradually, a voice came over, congratulating Feng Dou and Mo Gui for successfully clearing the level together. This immediately surprised Mo Gui. He was also a blessing in disguise.
He laughed and said: "No wonder so many people fail to pass this level. It's really laughable! It's a level that can only be passed like this. Let me ask you, if you give me a hundred more chances, I won't be able to pass this level. In fact, for a rule-abiding person like me, I will never be able to do it."
Feng Douze smiled and said: "Doesn't this mean that I am acting randomly?"
"Haha! Brother Feng, I really relied on you to help me with this! Otherwise, I would never have been able to complete this level. Needless to say, in the future, whenever I need my help, I will never refuse. I will definitely complete it well for you."
Of course Feng Dou's words just now were a joke. After hearing Mo Gui's words, he naturally understood what he meant. He smiled and said: "Brother Mo, you are too polite. It is a coincidence that we can pass the level to a certain extent! I just wanted to give it a try, but our luck is really good, otherwise we would not have succeeded! In this case, should we enter the next level?"
After Mo Gui thought for a while, he said, "We still have to wait for Lao Qiu!"
